title: Raft snapshot install rebuilds the trigram index
phase: P5 Distributed coherence (466 series, first slice)
discovery: replace_visible_entries_for_snapshot rebuilt only the vector index after installing snapshot entries; the trigram index kept pre-snapshot postings (or stayed empty on a fresh follower), so trigram-served wildcard LIKE answered from stale state. Found by the 465 adversarial review, verified.

changes.catalog: Column::is_trigram_text_column() — single source of truth for trigram eligibility (was a private predicate in dml/mod.rs)
changes.fusion: rebuild_trigram_index() mirroring rebuild_vector_index (schema scan -> per-table trigram columns -> data scan -> postings); wired after the vector rebuild in replace_visible_entries_for_snapshot with a fresh TrigramIndex

verification: test_snapshot_install_rebuilds_trigram_index (export visible state, wipe in-memory trigram simulating a fresh follower, install, assert postings + LIKE results); full gate green
disclosures: mirrors the vector rebuild's legacy data:-prefix scan (sharded shard:N:data: prefixes not scanned — same pre-existing limitation as the vector rebuild, one fix for both later)
466 series remainder open: deterministic KvBatch replication (leader captures OCC write set + side deltas, apply-time deterministic revalidation), pgwire DML through Raft, vote/log persistence
